oneOf.description: First message on every connection, answering the client's hello.

its status, account, project, title or queue changes.

Every host whose sessions a vault lists, with its liveness; sent by a vault only, after
hello and whenever a host connects, disconnects or first replicates. A daemon never
sends it: its sessions all run on its own host.

it changes. Clients merge the lists of all their daemons by `project_id`.
Every account on this daemon with its usage; sent after hello and whenever any of it changes.

oneOf.description: Every open terminal on this daemon; sent to owners only, after hello and whenever the set changes.

The host's load and turn admission; ephemeral, never journaled. Sent after hello, then
whenever it changes, at most once every two seconds.

What one session's processes and containers use; ephemeral, never journaled. Sent after
hello for every session with something running, then whenever its usage changes, at
most once every two seconds per session.

The skill library as this daemon has it; ephemeral, never journaled. Sent after hello,
then whenever it changes.

The skills one session's agent may use: the library's enabled skills and the project's
skills in its worktree; ephemeral, never journaled. Sent after hello for every live
session, then whenever they change. An empty list is sent once, as when the session is
archived, and then no longer to clients that connect later.

enabled.description: Whether sessions get generated titles at all.

model.description: Model, in that provider's naming; the provider's quick model when absent.

provider.description: Provider whose CLI titles, claude or codex; the session's account's when absent.

oneOf.description: The daemon's automatic titler, unasked; it replaces only an earlier `auto` title.

Generated from the conversation so far at a user's `retitle_session`, which `by` names.
It replaces any earlier title, a `user` one too; the automatic titler leaves it alone.
Typed by a user in `rename_session`; the automatic titler leaves it alone.

class.description: What kind of failure, which decides what can be done about it.

message.description: Human-readable detail from the provider or daemon.

TurnId.description: Identifies a turn within a session; a ULID string, opaque to receivers.

UsageWindow.description: Usage of one provider limit window, such as a five-hour or weekly limit.

resets_at.description: When the window resets; absent when the provider does not say.

used_percent.description: Share of the window's limit used, from 0 to 100.

window.description: Window name, in the provider's own naming.

UserId.description: Identifies a named user of a daemon; a ULID string, opaque to receivers.

VaultStatus.description: What a vault holds, in total and per host.

events.description: Journal events held, of every copy.

hosts.description:
Each host that replicated here, ordered by host id; the same hosts as
[`ServerMessage::Hosts`].

sessions.description: Sessions the vault lists: every host's, without copies another host took over.

storage_bytes.description: Size of the vault's database, in bytes.

VaultVolume.description: The disk the vault keeps its database on.

total_bytes.description: Size of the volume, in bytes.

used_bytes.description: Bytes in use, by the vault or anything else.
